biography: Toby Price, a name whispered with respect in the Super Trophy Trucks circuit, hails from the arid heart of Australia. Born and raised amidst the red dust and relentless sun of the Outback, Toby's connection to motorsport began early, tinkering with his father's battered utility vehicle. He wasn't drawn to paved tracks; his calling was the raw, untamed terrain. His breakthrough came at 18, securing a wildcard entry into a regional Trophy Truck series. Despite his inexperience, Toby displayed an uncanny ability to read the terrain, navigating treacherous obstacles with a steady hand and an almost preternatural awareness. While he is still considered rising, his consistency and calculated aggression have caught the attention of veteran teams, marking him as a talent to watch. Currently, Toby is focused on solidifying his position within Super Trophy Trucks, aiming to prove that his early success was no fluke.
drivingStyle: Toby's driving style is a study in calculated aggression. He isn't one for flamboyant displays of speed, preferring a methodical approach. He excels at tire management, understanding the delicate balance between pushing the limits and preserving grip. In corners, he favors a late-braking technique, setting up precise entries and maximizing exit speed. Under pressure, Toby remains remarkably composed, making him a formidable opponent in close races.
